incidental_policy: Any structurally bounded JSON type; never retain incidental values or select on them. This is not a claim about deployed types.
unknown_fields: Root and result-row keys must be allowlisted; other keys nested within named incidental containers are structurally bounded and discarded. Unknown root or row keys terminate with fixed diagnostics only.
semantic_types: link and title are nonempty bounded strings; title rejects whitespace-only and C0/C1 controls; format is an allowed string; populated dates are strings and may otherwise be null; total and start are nonnegative integers excluding booleans.
enumeration: Integer start zero; integer total exactly equals result count; at most 100 rows. This proves only response-shape consistency, not publisher-index completeness.
locator: Relative /government/statistics/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]* only; no duplicate locators; no URL access.

date_policy.populated_dates: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS with optional fractional seconds and required Z or signed HH:MM timezone; valid calendar/time/offset required; lexical text preserved

retention.fingerprint_identity: Exact returned link string UTF-8 bytes, not canonical URL identities or a replacement for the cumulative exposure chain.
retention.exposure_complete_meaning: Every returned result row has a string link whose exact bytes were hashed after bounded parsing; does not mean total/start enumeration, index or historical exposure completeness. May remain true on semantic failure.
